import java.util.*;
public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 2000005;
    static int total, start, end_point, n, m, k_param, c_param, d_param;
    static int[] edge_next = new int[MAX], head = new int[MAX], dest = new int[MAX], capacity = new int[MAX], cost = new int[MAX], dist = new int[MAX], visited = new int[MAX], flow = new int[MAX], current = new int[MAX], xs, ys;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    
    static void connect(int a, int b, int z, int v) {
        edge_next[++total] = head[a];
        head[a] = total;
        dest[total] = b;
        capacity[total] = z;
        cost[total] = v;
        edge_next[++total] = head[b];
        head[b] = total;
        dest[total] = a;
        capacity[total] = 0;
        cost[total] = -v;
    }
    
    static boolean shortest_path() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        q.clear();
        q.add(start);
        dist[start] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int current_node = q.poll();
            visited[current_node] = 0;
            for (int i = head[current_node]; i != 0; i = edge_next[i]) {
                if (capacity[i] > 0 && dist[dest[i]] > dist[current_node] + cost[i]) {
                    dist[dest[i]] = dist[current_node] + cost[i];
                    if (visited[dest[i]] == 0) {
                        visited[dest[i]] = 1;
                        q.add(dest[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[end_point] <= 1000000000;
    }
    
    static int augment(int node, int flow_in) {
        int total_flow = 0, flow_bottle;
        visited[node] = 1;
        if (node == end_point) return flow_in;
        for (int i = current[node]; i != 0; i = edge_next[i]) {
            if (visited[dest[i]] == 0 && capacity[i] > 0 && dist[dest[i]] == dist[node] + cost[i]) {
                int min_flow = Math.min(flow_in, capacity[i]);
                flow_bottle = augment(dest[i], min_flow);
                if (flow_bottle > 0) {
                    capacity[i] -= flow_bottle;
                    capacity[i ^ 1] += flow_bottle;
                    total_flow += flow_bottle;
                    flow_in -= flow_bottle;
                    if (flow_in == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return total_flow;
    }
    
    static int gao() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (shortest_path()) {
            System.arraycopy(head, 0, current, 0, head.length);
            flow += augment(start, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
        return flow;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k_param = sc.nextInt();
        c_param = sc.nextInt();
        d_param = sc.nextInt();
        start = 0;
        end_point = 1;
        total = 1;
        xs = new int[m + 1];
        ys = new int[m + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= k_param; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            connect(start, x + 1, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            xs[i] = sc.nextInt();
            ys[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k_param; i++) {
            connect(2 + i * n, end_point, k_param, 0);
            if (i == n + k_param) break;
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int l = k_param; l >= 0; l--) {
                    int from = xs[j] + 1 + i * n;
                    int to = ys[j] + 1 + i * n + n;
                    connect(from, to, 1, (l * 2 + 1) * d_param + c_param);
                    connect(to, from, 1, (l * 2 + 1) * d_param + c_param);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                connect(j + 1 + i * n, j + 1 + i * n + n, k_param, c_param);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(gao());
        sc.close();
    }
}
